/app_security/authorized_third_party_app: Reads accounts:num_authorized_apps from the customer usage report.
/device_access/managed_device_required: Writes true when a Context-Aware Access deny event in the 90 days before the run sets CAA_DEVICE_STATE, and leaves the value out otherwise.
/lifecycle/account_count: Reads accounts:num_users from the customer usage report.
/lifecycle/accounts_present: Checks whether the usage report's accounts:num_users is above 0.
/lifecycle/archived_account_count: Reads accounts:num_archived_users from the customer usage report.
/lifecycle/archived_pct: Divides archived_account_count by account_count, rounded up.
/lifecycle/suspended_account_count: Reads accounts:num_suspended_users from the customer usage report.
/lifecycle/suspended_pct: Divides suspended_account_count by account_count, rounded up.
/policy/mfa_required: Checks whether every active Directory user has isEnforcedIn2Sv set. It is left out when an SSO assignment sends an org unit or group to a third-party SAML profile, since that identity provider decides those users' MFA.
/policy/mfa_required_coverage_pct: Divides mfa_required_user_count by user_security.user_count, rounded down. It is left out when an SSO assignment sends an org unit or group to a third-party SAML profile, since that identity provider decides those users' MFA.
/policy/mfa_required_user_count: Counts the active Directory users with isEnforcedIn2Sv set. It is left out when an SSO assignment sends an org unit or group to a third-party SAML profile, since that identity provider decides those users' MFA.
/policy/session_lifetime_max_min: Takes the longest webSessionDuration of the security.session_controls policies from the Policy API, in minutes, rounded up.
/privileged_access/privileged_mfa_covera: Divides privileged_mfa_user_count by privileged_users_count, rounded down. It is left out when a delegated admin is privileged and an SSO assignment sends an org unit or group to a third-party SAML profile. Super admins always sign in with Google.
/privileged_access/privileged_mfa_user_c: Counts the active privileged users with isEnrolledIn2Sv set. It is left out when a delegated admin is privileged and an SSO assignment sends an org unit or group to a third-party SAML profile. Super admins always sign in with Google.
/privileged_access/privileged_users_coun: Counts the active privileged Directory users. A super admin, with isAdmin set, is privileged. A delegated admin, with isDelegatedAdmin set, is privileged when a role assigned to them has a privilege that can change users, groups, org units, security, or settings, such as USERS_UPDATE or GROUPS_ALL. A role whose privileges only retrieve or read, such as USERS_RETRIEVE, does not count.
/privileged_access/privileged_users_pres: Checks whether any active Directory user is privileged. A super admin, with isAdmin set, is privileged. A delegated admin, with isDelegatedAdmin set, is privileged when a role assigned to them has a privilege that can change users, groups, org units, security, or settings, such as USERS_UPDATE or GROUPS_ALL. A role whose privileges only retrieve or read, such as USERS_RETRIEVE, does not count.
/privileged_access/standing_privileged_u: Writes 0 when privileged_users_count is 0, and leaves the value out otherwise.
Writes false when no active Directory user is privileged, as privileged_users_count counts them, and leaves the value out otherwise.
/privileged_access/super_admin_count: Counts the active Directory users with isAdmin set.
/user_security/inactive_pct: Divides inactive_user_count by user_count, rounded up.
/user_security/inactive_user_count: Counts the active users whose Directory lastLoginTime is more than 90 days before the run, or who never signed in.
/user_security/locked_out_pct: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_locked_users by its accounts:num_users, rounded up.
/user_security/mfa_coverage_pct: Takes the larger of two shares, rounded down. One is the active users with isEnrolledIn2Sv true, out of all active users. The other is the usage report's accounts:num_users_with_passkeys_enrolled, out of its accounts:num_users. It is left out when an SSO assignment sends an org unit or group to a third-party SAML profile, since that identity provider decides those users' MFA.
/user_security/mfa_phishing_resistant_pc: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_users_with_passkeys_enrolled by its accounts:num_users, rounded down. It is left out when an SSO assignment sends an org unit or group to a third-party SAML profile, since that identity provider decides those users' MFA.
/user_security/password_policy_noncompli: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_users_password_length_non_compliant by its accounts:num_users, rounded up.
/user_security/user_count: Counts the Directory users that are neither suspended nor archived.
/user_security/users_present: Checks whether any user in the live Directory scan is neither suspended nor archived.
/user_security/weak_password_pct: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_users_password_strength_weak by its accounts:num_users, rounded up.
